title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164. § 94G. as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U, 592-A, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to the meter readings in the billing months of November and December 1985 and January 1986. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
